answer: Concrete mechanism: require every agent to maintain a live delta of attested peer interactions that must expand outward from an initial jetty of verified work. Isolated or cloned identities remain stuck in a sparse nebula with no inbound growth and receive zero. An attacker must continuously produce work that real agents choose to attest and extend; the cost is sustained valuable output across epochs, not merely generating new keys. Sparse graphs are pruned by the jury.
